title: NERU THEE FOURTH FUGEE And BBYMUTHA Join Forces In ‘END DAZE’
htmlContent:
Neru Thee Fourth Fugee is back and better than ever with her latest single, ‘End Daze,’ featuring US rap icon BBYMUTHA. The hard-hitting collaboration is a sneak peek into Neru’s highly anticipated sophomore album, ‘Greater Than.’ With her signature style of fusing hip-hop, neo-soul, ambient, funk, and psychedelic music, Neru creates her own musical universe. ‘End Daze’ is no exception, with Neru and BBYMUTHA in only form as they flex their lyrical prowess throughout the track.

Neru Thee Fourth Fugee’s music transcends genres and offers a thought-provoking, mind-bending listening experience. The single is inspired by MF Doom and Vince Staples, with a double entendre in its title referencing both ‘End Days’ and ‘In Daze.’ The song is a balance of boastful and confident energy, making the listener feel powerful and ready to take on the world.

In addition to her music, Neru is also the founder of the Baltimore creative community, AstroKnot Collective, which curates youth drives, art residencies, music videos, concerts, community events, and more all over the city of Baltimore. With two critically acclaimed EPs and a seminal album already under her belt, Neru is poised to take the music world by storm with her sophomore album, ‘Greater Than.’
